text:
Echo State Networks (ESNs) are a type of recurrent neural network used for processing time-series data. They consist of a large, fixed-size, randomly connected hidden layer called a "reservoir," which processes input data. The weights of the reservoir are typically fixed, and only the output weights are trained using a simple linear regression. Training involves exposing the reservoir to input data and adjusting the output weights to minimize prediction error.
